items.title: Pacome Dadiet struggled to hit shots at Cote d'Ivorie was blown out by Angola. Dadiet was functioning as the primary playmaker for Cote d'Ivorie and finished with 6 assists against three turnovers. Overall, 10/5/6 for Dadiet.

items.title: Pacome Dadiet had 13 points on 5-for-15 shooting in Ivory Coast's victory over Egypt today. Dadiet shot poorly from two, but did hit 3-for-7 from deep. Also grabbed six rebounds in almost 24 minutes of play.
